description: This Java interface defines the service layer for reading and retrieving client-related data in the Fineract platform. It declares methods for fetching client details, lookup data, associated client IDs, and transfer proposal dates.

classes.name: ClientReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods for retrieving client data and related information from the platform.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of clients based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific client given their ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of clients based on extra criteria for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookupByOfficeId
methods.description: Retrieves clients associated with a specific office for lookup.

methods.name: retrieveClientByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves client data using a specified identifier type and key.

methods.name: retrieveClientMembersOfGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all clients that are members of a specified group.

methods.name: retrieveActiveClientMembersOfGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all active clients who are members of a specified group.

methods.name: retrieveActiveClientMembersOfCenter
methods.description: Retrieves all active clients who are members of a specified center.

methods.name: retrieveAllNarrations
methods.description: Retrieves narration data associated with clients.

methods.name: retrieveUserClients
methods.description: Gets a list of client IDs linked to a specific user ID, used for self-service authentication.

methods.name: retrieveClientTransferProposalDate
methods.description: Retrieves the transfer proposal date for a given client.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal client ID associated with an external ID.
